## Space Invaders — Plan Ready ✅

The exhaustive `plan.md` has been written to `Space_Invaders/plan.md`. Here's a summary of what it covers:

### 1. Core Gameplay
- **Player Ship:** Acceleration-based horizontal movement, single-projectile firing (0.3s cooldown), 3 lives with 2s invulnerability on respawn
- **Enemy Formation:** 5×11 grid (55 enemies), 5 distinct types with PBR emissive hierarchy (30→5 pts), formation accelerates as enemies are killed, edge-bounce + downward shift mechanic
- **Enemy Shooting:** Independent per-enemy fire rolls scaling with kill count (0.002→0.008/frame cap)
- **Shield System:** 4 destructible barriers, 3-cell HP degradation across 3 visual states via instanced mesh color attributes
- **Mystery UFO:** Random spawn every 15–25s, traverses screen top, 50–150 random pts

### 2. 20 AAA Modern Enhancements
PBR emissive enemy grid, dynamic formation point light, procedural starfield (500 instanced), neon perspective grid floor, ship particle trail, death fracture shards (8–12 per kill), shockwave rings on kills, hit-stop frame-freeze on player death, trauma-based camera shake (3 intensity tiers), motion trails on projectiles, full Web Audio synthesis (6 SFX types + ambient drone), floating score popups, glassmorphism HUD, procedural enemy silhouette geometry with vertex displacement, exponential fog, screen-space vignette post-process, barrier destruction spark bursts, wave transition cinematic (FOV zoom), localStorage high score persistence, strict performance budgets

### 3. Graphics Pipeline
- **Post-Processing:** `RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass (strength:1.5, radius:0.5, threshold:0.7) → Vignette ShaderPass`
- **Lighting:** Ambient fill + dynamic formation point light (hue-shifting) + cyan player spotlight + rim directional
- **Procedural Math:** Starfield distribution, grid floor shader with time-pulse, enemy silhouette vertex displacement, barrier cell HP color attributes

### 4. VFX Priority Logic
Camera shake (3 trigger tiers with per-axis damping), hit-stop (12-frame freeze + DOM flash), particle bursts (enemy death: 15 sparks, player death: 40, UFO: 25, barrier: 8), shockwave rings (pooled, max 15 active), motion trails (player: 8 positions, enemy: 4), floating score text (screen-projected HTML overlay)

### 5. File Architecture
```
Space_Invaders/
├── index.html / styles.css / main.js
└── src/
    ├── Game.js                    # Orchestration + game loop
    ├── simulation/                # Pure logic — no Three.js
    │   ├── Player.js, EnemyGrid.js, Enemy.js
    │   ├── Bullet.js → PlayerBullet.js, EnemyBullet.js
    │   ├── Shield.js, UFO.js, GameState.js
    ├── render/                    # Three.js only — no game logic
    │   ├── Renderer.js, Starfield.js, GridFloor.js, PostProcessing.js
    │   ├── EnemyMeshFactory.js, PlayerMesh.js, ProjectileRenderer.js
    │   ├── ShieldRenderer.js, UFOVisuals.js
    └── utils/
        ├── Collision.js, MathHelpers.js, Constants.js
```

**Import discipline:** `simulation/` → `render/` only for visual state queries. Shared utilities injected through `Game.js`. No circular dependencies. All imports relative.
